description: This file defines the KeyEscapeUtil class which provides utility methods for escaping strings to be valid MongoDB keys by replacing special characters with encoded sequences.

classes.name: KeyEscapeUtil
classes.description: A final utility class that provides static methods to escape strings for MongoDB keys.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes the input string by replacing '~', '$', and '.' characters with specific sequences to make the string a valid MongoDB key.
